zoe.sales: Heads up team 12: enterprise wants a 10-business-day Dedicated POC. Their security team requires a single IPv4 (one /32) for egress allowlist, and theyd like per-environment API tokens (dev/stage/poc). They also asked for a short SOW blurb and lead time.
adan.eng: We can issue per-project tokens scoped to a Dedicated endpoint and set TTLs for POC tokens. Good to propose timeboxed tokens + short TTL.
maya.net: For a guaranteed single /32 on Azure or GCP we need to reserve a static public IP (or public IP prefix with a single address) and attach it to our NAT Gateway. Important: if they expect cross-AZ burst or auto-scaling across regions, the IP could change unless we pin the egress path.
zoe.sales: So we should lock HA down in the SOW if they want no rotation?
adan.eng: Exactly  include an explicit constraint: "POC cluster will be constrained to a single egress gateway and AZ to guarantee the provided static IP; cross-AZ failover will be disabled for the POC window." Call that out as a tradeoff.
claire.solutions: Suggested SOW snippet to paste: "Provision temporary Dedicated cluster (4 GPUs), allocate one static public IPv4 for outbound traffic, generate time-limited API tokens scoped to the POC project, run connectivity smoke tests, and provide monitoring access. Customer to add provided IP and hostname to their perimeter allowlist."
maya.net: Also ask if their perimeter does IP-only or SNI/hostname checks. If they validate SNI, we should ask them to allow the Dedicated hostname too. Some corporate proxies strip SNI so both are advised.
zoe.sales: Any sample firewall rules I can send?
maya.net: Yes  send both IP and hostname:
ALLOW TCP 443 to 198.51.100.99/32
ALLOW HOST: dedicated.west.redwood.example.com
And mention to allow long-lived TLS sessions and outbound WebSocket traffic if they plan streaming.
adan.eng: Smoke-test curl for them to run after allowlist update:
```
curl -X POST https://dedicated.west.redwood.example.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"healthcheck"}'
```
claire.solutions: Pricing phrasing for the sales email: "POC pricing is a pro-rated Dedicated reservation plus a one-time provisioning fee; we often offer discretionary credits for short evaluations—finance will confirm final numbers."
zoe.sales: Lead time to stand this up if SOW signed today?
maya.net: Typical path: reserve public IP (same day if in our pool, otherwise 1 business day), create Dedicated cluster and attach NAT (1 business day), token + tests (same day) => estimate 48-72 hours. If they choose private peering (no public IP) add 3-7 business days for network approvals.
infra-bot: Provisioning ticket created INF-4725: reserve IP 198.51.100.99 and schedule Dedicated cluster. Assigned maya.net. ETA 72h. :white_check_mark:
zoe.sales: Thanks team  I'll send both options (1) static IP + timeboxed tokens (fast), (2) VPC/private endpoint (longer, zero public IP). Will attach SOW snippet and ask which they prefer.
